example_questions: How long can I leave my pond unattended before algae?

axes.why_it_matters: Checked from NASA data. Its effect on algae is not sourced here.

axes.name: shade
axes.label: Shade over the pond
axes.prompt: How much of the pond is shaded?
axes.why_it_matters: Only you can tell us this. Its effect is not sourced here.

axes.name: pond_size
axes.label: Pond size
axes.prompt: Roughly how big is the pond?
axes.why_it_matters: Only you can tell us this. Its effect is not sourced here.

axes.name: fed_stocked
axes.label: Fish stocked or fed
axes.prompt: Is the pond stocked with fish, and do you feed them?
axes.why_it_matters: Only you can tell us this. Its effect is not sourced here.

risk_window_rule.definition: The 3 calendar months with the highest average air temperature in this record. This is a simple project choice, not a sourced rule.

domains.abstain_policy: If any critical axis is not analyzed, give a risk window and no number of days.

example_questions: Why are my oranges so small this year?

axes.name: region
axes.label: Where the trees are
axes.prompt: Which region are the trees in?
axes.why_it_matters: Climate data is only meaningful for a specific place.

axes.label: Air temperature
axes.why_it_matters: Checked from NASA data. Its effect on fruit size is not sourced here.

axes.label: Rainfall
axes.why_it_matters: Checked from NASA data. Its effect on fruit size is not sourced here.

axes.name: sunlight
axes.label: Sunlight
axes.why_it_matters: Checked from NASA data when available. Its effect on fruit size is not sourced here.

axes.name: night_temp
axes.label: Night-time temperature

axes.name: crop_load
axes.label: Amount of fruit on the trees

axes.name: fruit_size_series
axes.label: Your own fruit-size records
axes.prompt: Do you have fruit-size records by year? (optional)
axes.why_it_matters: NASA has no fruit-size data. Your records are the only way to link size to climate.

domains.abstain_policy: The data cannot say why fruit is small. Report climate trends only and abstain on the cause.
